Research Intern, Robotics (Summer 2027)

Los Altos, CA
Research
Intern
Who we are
At Example Corp, we're on a mission to improve the quality of human life through robotics research. Our internship program places students with a mentor on a research team for twelve weeks, working on perception, planning, or learning problems that matter to the lab's roadmap.

The role
You will join one research team for the summer, define a project with your mentor in the first two weeks, and present it at the end-of-summer symposium. Many intern projects become workshop papers.

What you will do

  • Implement and evaluate learning or planning algorithms on real robot data.
  • Write up your results in a technical report.
  • Take part in the lab's reading groups and demos.

Qualifications

  • Enrolled in a master's or PhD program in robotics, computer science, or a related field through at least December 2027.
  • Strong Python; C++ is a plus.
  • Authorized to work in the United States for the internship.
Example Corp is an equal opportunity employer.
